entries.name: apple/coreai-models
entries.why: Apple's official Core AI export recipes, Python primitives and Swift runtime utilities. Requires iOS/macOS 27 and Xcode 27. Not accepting PRs at launch.

entries.name: john-rocky/coreai-model-zoo
entries.why: Swift-focused model zoo converting open LLMs (e.g., Qwen3.5, Gemma 4) to Core AI. The most active community zoo found.

entries.name: CYBRTRK2/coreai-model-zoo
entries.why: Community zoo with 66 Core AI models across LLM, VLM, OCR, ASR, TTS and image/video. Newer project.

entries.name: huggingface/AnyLanguageModel
entries.why: Drop-in, API-compatible replacement for Apple's Foundation Models framework that adds other backends. Use it to test or ship beyond Apple Intelligence devices.

entries.name: AppStorage/FoundationChat
entries.why: SwiftUI chat app on Foundation Models (MIT). Written for Xcode 26; needs updates to build on Xcode 27.

entries.name: artemnovichkov/HotdogApp
entries.why: Minimal Foundation Models sample app for guided prompting. Builds on Xcode 27.1.

entries.name: AddikiPraveenKumar/foundation-models-ios-guide
entries.why: Written guide to Foundation Models on iOS 26, focused on privacy-first features.

entries.name: GijungKim/expo-local-llm
entries.why: Expo module running on-device LLMs via Foundation Models on iOS and Gemini Nano on Android. Use for cross-platform React Native apps.

entries.name: dromerosm/fm-smishing-bench
entries.why: Reproducible benchmark of Foundation Models on SMS scam detection. A public eval for on-device LLM output.

entries.name: apple/coremltools
entries.why: Apple's Python tools to convert, edit and validate Core ML models from PyTorch and TensorFlow. Start here for any conversion.

entries.name: john-rocky/CoreML-Models
entries.why: Model zoo of PyTorch models converted to ready-to-use .mlpackage files for iOS/macOS, with conversion notes per model. Updated this week.

entries.name: apple-aiml-research/ml-stable-diffusion
entries.why: Apple's reference for running Stable Diffusion with Core ML on Apple silicon, including a Swift package.

entries.name: apple-aiml-research/ml-ane-transformers
entries.why: Reference Transformer implementation optimized for the Apple Neural Engine. Use when latency or battery matters for a Core ML model.

entries.name: huggingface/swift-coreml-diffusers
entries.why: Swift app demonstrating Core ML Stable Diffusion. Archived, so use Apple's ml-stable-diffusion for current code.

entries.name: likedan/Awesome-CoreML-Models
entries.why: Large curated index of Core ML models. Last pushed June 2025; many links may be dead.

entries.name: ml-explore/mlx-swift
entries.why: Swift API for Apple's MLX array framework on Apple silicon. Base layer for the LLM packages below.

entries.name: ml-explore/mlx-swift-lm
entries.why: Run and fine-tune LLMs and VLMs in Swift. iOS 17+. Includes an MLXFoundationModels bridge for Apple's LanguageModelSession.

entries.name: ml-explore/mlx-swift-examples
entries.why: Sample apps for iOS and macOS: MLXChatExample, LLMEval, StableDiffusionExample. MLXChatExample builds on Xcode 27.1.

entries.name: ggml-org/llama.cpp
entries.why: C/C++ LLM inference for GGUF models; the most widely used local runtime. Build for iOS and call from Swift via C interop.

entries.name: mlc-ai/mlc-llm
entries.why: Compiled LLM deployment engine that targets iOS and other platforms. Use when you need one compiled model across devices.

entries.name: huggingface/swift-transformers
entries.why: Swift package for tokenizers and Hugging Face Hub access. Needed for most Swift LLM apps that load models from the Hub.

entries.name: argmaxinc/argmax-oss-swift
entries.why: On-device speech AI for Apple silicon (formerly WhisperKit). WhisperAX example builds on Xcode 27.1. Swift-native option for on-device transcription.

entries.name: ggml-org/whisper.cpp
entries.why: C/C++ port of OpenAI's Whisper. Widely used on mobile; usable from Swift via C interop.

entries.name: tucan9389/awesome-ml-demos-with-ios
entries.why: Sample projects running ML models on iOS. Last pushed 2021; useful for patterns, not current APIs.

entries.name: onmyway133/awesome-machine-learning
entries.why: Curated ML resources with a Core ML focus. Active.
